Both paths allocate a 36-byte vertex-buffer descriptor (stored at *(this+80)+28), fill it with size 32, width = this+44 * this+36, height = this+44 * this+40, stride 64 and format 1234, create it via sub_540DF0(dword_8B78A0, desc), then allocate a 28-byte index-buffer descriptor (stored at *(this+80)+36) filled with count 2 and the mesh height, created via sub_540FC0(dword_8B78A0, desc). ConditionalFieldSetter_0d40 then finishes setup. Bit-0 path writes render-state texture-coordinate pairs (at *(*(this+80)+12)+28/+32, values 0 / 1.0) and one triangle-strip index pattern per row (12 index words) with a row stride of this+36; bit-1 path writes six vertex texture-coordinate pairs per row and a denser index pattern whose flavor is chosen by flag bit 0x10 of *(this+80) (mesh object flags). Finally the generated index data is copied from the source buffer *(this+80)+20 to the destination *(this+80)+40 (size 2 * this+44 * this+40 when the signed byte at this+32 is non-negative, or 2 * mesh height otherwise), followed by ConditionalBitmaskCleanup(*(this+80), 12) and return 0. Any creation failure routes to sub_53C590(-1, aErrorCreatingV) and returns -1.

Create the vertex buffer by calling sub_540DF0(dword_8B78A0, *(this+80)+28); a non-zero return skips to the failure path.

Copy the generated index data from the source buffer *(this+80)+20 to the destination buffer *(this+80)+40 via qmemcpy; the byte count is 2 * this+44 * this+40 on the non-negative path (guard:1) or 2 * the mesh height field from *(this+80)+16 on the negative path (guard:0). Then run ConditionalBitmaskCleanup(*(this+80), 12) and return 0.
